SELECT KK.* ,ROWNUM RN FROM( SELECT /*selectMasterMpStSgResultList*/ A.SG_ID , NVL((SELECT X.SG_NAME FROM KEPSGMG X WHERE X.SG_ID = A.SG_ID AND ROWNUM =1),'미분류') AS SG_NM , ROUND(SUM(A.SALES_AMT),0) AS SALES_AMT , ROUND(SUM(A.MARGIN_AMT),0) AS SALES_PROFIT , RTRIM(TO_CHAR(ROUND(decode(SUM(A.SALES_AMT) , 0, 0 ,SUM(A.MARGIN_AMT) / SUM(A.SALES_AMT)* 100),1), 'FM999990.0'),'.')||'%' SALES_PROFIT_RATE , RTRIM(TO_CHAR(ROUND(decode(B.TOT_SALES , 0, 0 ,SUM(A.SALES_AMT) / B.TOT_SALES* 100),1), 'FM999990.0'),'.')||'%' SALES_PORTION , RTRIM(TO_CHAR(ROUND(decode(B.TOT_MARGIN , 0, 0 ,SUM(A.MARGIN_AMT) / B.TOT_MARGIN* 100),1), 'FM999990.0'),'.')||'%' SALES_PROFIT_PORTION FROM BNTMIS_CUST A, ( SELECT X.YYYY , SUM(X.SALES_AMT) AS TOT_SALES , SUM(X.MARGIN_AMT) AS TOT_MARGIN FROM BNTMIS_CUST X, ICOMCMPY C, BNTBUYERGROUP D WHERE X.BUYER = C.COM_CODE AND C.CORP_CODE = D.CORP_CODE
AND X.YYYY='${st_year}'
AND X.KEP_DEPT = '${st_user_dept}'
AND D.GROUP_CODE = '${st_buyer_group}'
AND D.CORP_CODE = '${st_corp_code}'
GROUP BY X.YYYY ) B, ICOMCMPY C, BNTBUYERGROUP D, ICOMCOD2 E WHERE A.YYYY = B.YYYY AND A.BUYER = C.COM_CODE AND C.CORP_CODE = D.CORP_CODE AND A.KEP_DEPT = E.CODE AND E.TYPE = 'C001' AND E.COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001'
AND A.YYYY='${st_year}'
AND A.KEP_DEPT = '${st_user_dept}'
AND D.GROUP_CODE = '${st_buyer_group}'
AND D.CORP_CODE = '${st_corp_code}'
GROUP BY A.SG_ID , B.TOT_SALES , B.TOT_MARGIN ORDER BY SALES_AMT desc ) kk

SELECT /*selectMasterMpStCategoryRecordPopList*/ A.SG_ID , NVL((SELECT X.SG_NAME FROM KEPSGMG X WHERE X.SG_ID = A.SG_ID AND ROWNUM =1),'미분류') AS SG_NM , ROUND(SUM(A.SALES_AMT),0) AS SALES_AMT , ROUND(SUM(A.MARGIN_AMT),0) AS SALES_PROFIT , RTRIM(TO_CHAR(ROUND(decode(SUM(A.SALES_AMT) , 0, 0 ,SUM(A.MARGIN_AMT) / SUM(A.SALES_AMT)* 100),1), 'FM999990.0'),'.')||'%' SALES_PROFIT_RATE , ROUND(decode(B.TOT_SALES , 0, 0 ,SUM(A.SALES_AMT) / B.TOT_SALES* 100),1) SALES_PORTION , ROUND(decode(B.TOT_MARGIN , 0, 0 ,SUM(A.MARGIN_AMT) / B.TOT_MARGIN* 100),1) SALES_PROFIT_PORTION FROM BNTMIS_CUST A, ( SELECT YYYY , SUM(SALES_AMT) AS TOT_SALES , SUM(MARGIN_AMT) AS TOT_MARGIN FROM BNTMIS_CUST GROUP BY YYYY ) B, ICOMCMPY C, BNTBUYERGROUP D, ICOMCOD2 E WHERE A.YYYY = B.YYYY AND A.BUYER = C.COM_CODE AND C.CORP_CODE = D.CORP_CODE AND A.KEP_DEPT = E.CODE AND E.TYPE = 'C001' AND E.COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001'
AND A.SG_ID = '${st_sg_cd}'
GROUP BY A.SG_ID , B.TOT_SALES , B.TOT_MARGIN ORDER BY SG_NM
